description: Grammar concrete syntax trees for the inventory sources and the shared embedded-language fixtures of parity/fixtures/issue-195-evidence.json, produced directly by the pinned tree-sitter grammars (no meta-language adapter) and cross-checked with the native tree-sitter CLI. Row: [depth, field, kind, named, startByte, endByte, flags]; flags: E error, M missing, X extra.

publicProjections.Lean: The public root is a `file` node spanning the whole source whose only grammar child is the grammar root `module`.
publicProjections.Rocq: Every `ident` leaf keeps its grammar node and gains one child token named `identifier`, or `primitive_type` for bool, nat, Prop, Set, SProp, Type and Z.
publicProjections.Markdown: Each block `inline` and `pipe_table_cell` node holds the children of the inline grammar tree parsed over its range minus its named children after the first (upstream MarkdownParser included ranges); those excluded block children sit under the deepest inline node containing them, otherwise among the children by start byte, block nodes first on ties.
publicProjections.CSS style attribute: A declaration list without a final `;` or `}` is parsed with `;` appended; nodes after the attribute value are dropped and ends are clipped to it.
publicProjections.Zero-width nodes: MISSING nodes and other zero-width grammar nodes are Syntax links without a source token.
